method.contribution: A pixel on pure void meets the phase threshold and loses at least 5 luma when this puff alone is hidden; puffs may share pixels.
method.exclusive: A threshold pixel on pure void changes when this puff is hidden but not when any other puff is hidden.
method.solo: Peak on pure void when only this puff is visible; this is not a measurement of the full composite.
method.screenMask: Exact 1280×720 screenshot difference between the same frame with and without smoke; the paired frame and binary mask are saved for every sample.
method.checks: The exact screen smoke-mask peak is at least 110 by day/sunset and 70 at night; night masks remain dimmer than both front-window samples; no brightening with lights and fog off. Per-puff overlap counts are diagnostic only.
